args.command: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p = 'F:\0wsh\asd'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { 'TARGET_EXISTS'; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Force -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 30 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}|{1}|{2}' -f $_.LastWriteTime, $_.Length, $_.FullName) } } else { 'TARGET_MISSING'; $q='F:\0wsh'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $q) { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $q -Force | Select-Object -First 30 -ExpandProperty FullName } }
